Method of Attack: DNS request leak exposing domains visited to third-party DNS servers, typically the user's ISP, when split tunneling feature is active
Bug caused DNS queries to bypass ExpressVPN's logless DNS servers and go to ISP DNS servers, allowing tracking of browsing habits
Impacted Systems: Windows versions 12.23.1 to 12.72.0 with split tunneling feature active
Attack Vector: Split tunneling feature in ExpressVPN Windows client
